title: GRAID: Synthetic Data Generation with Geometric Constraints and Multi-Agentic Reflection for Harmful Content Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the stylistic, linguistic, and semantic diversity of synthetic datasets using metrics such as Distinct-1, Distinct-2, ROUGE-L, Jaccard similarity, and average sentence length to ensure broad coverage of semantic concepts.

Analyzing the distribution and clustering of prompt representations in the embedding space using UMAP and density heatmaps, and enforcing diversity constraints via cosine similarity thresholds using sentence transformers.
